$comment: The friction journal format, owned by @maxvyshniakov/repo-kit. Other writers keep a pinned copy with its SHA-256 and run every case. Changing schema needs a new schema.version and new cases.
name: friction-journal

fields.name: ts
fields.description: ISO 8601 time of the moment: matches pattern and parses as a date and time

fields.name: project
fields.description: consuming repository; a linked worktree names its main repository

fields.name: package
fields.description: npm name of the package the friction is about

fields.name: rule
fields.description: lint rule, TypeScript code (TS2322) or review category

fields.name: detail
fields.description: local text, at most limits.detail long; never exported as written

fields.name: why
fields.description: why a hook or scanner flagged it

fields.name: file
fields.description: path relative to the project, or to the package for a vendored copy

fields.name: fingerprint
fields.description: stable key of the underlying fact, so repeats count apart from distinct facts

rules.required: a required string field is a string with a non-whitespace character; v equals version; ts matches its pattern and parses
rules.optional: an optional field is missing, null or a string
rules.extra: readers keep and ignore fields the schema does not name
rules.version: readers skip and count lines of another version; renaming, retyping or removing a field, a new required field, a new kind or a changed limit is a new version
rules.problems: a validator reports, in this order: not an object (alone); v; ts; each required string field in field order; kind; each string field other than ts that is neither missing, null nor a string, in field order; detail longer than limits.detail
rules.line: one JSON object per line: no whitespace between tokens, every field in field order, characters outside ASCII as UTF-8 except lone surrogates (\udxxx, lowercase), control characters U+0000-U+001F escaped (\b \t \n \f \r, else \u00xx lowercase), ended by \n and appended in one write (O_APPEND)
rules.lineLimit: when the line is longer than limits.line, detail loses its last (line length - limits.line) units once and the line is written again

build.ts: the given ts, else the time of building as ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds and Z (2026-11-12T00:00:00.000Z)
build.project: the given project, else the name of the directory holding .git above the working directory (a linked worktree's .git file names its main repository), else the working directory's own name

session.rule: the given session, else the first of env that is set and not empty, else null

build.text: a field given as missing, null or empty string is null; detail is a string (empty when not given) cut to limits.detail
build.defaults: package and source have no default here: each writer gives them

write.order: every schema field in field order, a missing one as null, then the fields the schema does not name in their own order
write.detail: a string detail longer than limits.detail is cut to it, as build cuts it
write.refuse: then the event is validated: one with problems is not written, and the writer reports the refusal (an error, a log line) instead of dropping it silently

fingerprint.rule: the first length hex digits of the digest of the parts, as text, joined by separator

note.rule: replace each remove match with a space; a note still matching dropNoteIf is code and becomes empty; split on whitespace; drop words matching a dropWordIf; strip trimWord; keep words matching keepWordIf; join the first maxWords with one space

identifier.rule: an exported component or rule that does not match becomes (other)

packageName.rule: an event whose package does not match is left out of an export

redaction.exported: package, component, rule and kind with counts and template paraphrases; never projects, sessions, files, times or detail text
